Neighbor counting, blocking count retrieval, CPU CSR-offset construction, and neighbor filling are all inside qtClustering.
Candidate distance caches are initialized during GPU candidate growth.
Candidate selection and distance-cache updates perform further on-demand algorithmic computation.
Candidate kernels complete through blocking copies before joined OpenMP winner selection and the clustering Allreduce.
Winner reconstruction, membership broadcast, host/device membership updates, and final device synchronization occur before return.
